title: PLSsemLab: A jamovi Module for Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling

creators.name: Chacón Chacón, Arquímedes De León
creators.affiliation: Universidad Católica Andrés Bello (UCAB), Caracas, Venezuela

description: An open-source jamovi module that brings partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to jamovi with the cSEM R package: models built from boxes; PLS and consistent PLS with PLS-PM, GSCA, SUMCORR, MAXVAR, PCA or unit weights; reliability and validity (HTMT and HTMT2 with bootstrap intervals; Mardia's multivariate normality of the indicators); structural model with blockwise bootstrap or jackknife; higher-order constructs and two-way interactions with simple slopes and Johnson-Neyman; overall model fit by bootstrap (SRMR, d_G, d_L); PLSpredict, CVPAT, model comparison, mediation, importance-performance map (IPMA), necessary condition analysis (NCA) and multigroup analysis (MICOM, PLS-MGA, permutation tests and measurement invariance with multigroup CFA). Every result is paired with evidence-based methodological guidance, interpretation and educational support in English and Spanish.
